_comment: AS/NZS 4671 reinforcement grades, as invoked by AS 3600 Section 3.2.
REFERENCE DATA (ASET component 1). See concrete_grades.json for the
verification stance -- it applies identically here.
fsu and uniform_elongation are recorded from the grade designation and are
the values most in need of checking; nothing in the current package uses
them, but a future strut-and-tie or anchorage module will.

grades.note: Grade 500 normal-ductility deformed bar. The default.
